_decision_contract: DD-89: direct DML on projector_deliveries/surface_refs is forbidden; pg-boss provisioning stays under the isolated migration credential and runtime stays migrate:false. DD-90: one audit row per claimed outbox event; job_definer is NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS and pre-provisioned; worker preflight belongs to slice 2 before boss.start().
_implementation_contract: Outbox claim retains ORDER BY created_at. A fixed five-minute lease is represented by claimed_at plus lease_expires_at. claim_outbox_batch first reclaims only expired leases under SKIP LOCKED, then claims only unclaimed rows; every successful claim and reclaim writes an audit row. Invalid p_limit outside 1..100 fails closed.

projector_deliveries gets token-and-lease ownership. job_prepare_projector_delivery is idempotent; claim_projector_delivery_batch returns only event_id, tenant_id, projector, claim_token and attempt count; completion requires the exact unexpired token and permits only delivered, retry or dlq. Retry scheduling policy remains a future projector concern, but the supplied next_attempt_at must be strictly future; no function accepts a tenant id or arbitrary DML fragment.

job_audit_events is append-only with no UNIQUE(job_id): a reclaimed event is legitimately claimed more than once. Every row is derived in the definer function and stores event job_id, non-null tenant_id, system actor, closed reason/function name, operation UUID and timestamp. app/readonly/app_worker receive no table grant; UPDATE/DELETE are trigger-rejected.

job_definer must be pre-provisioned by a privileged cluster bootstrap with exact NOLOGIN NOSUPERUSER BYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOINHERIT NOREPLICATION attributes and membership granted to the migration owner. The job-core migration only asserts this, brackets CREATE ON public for ownership transfer, explicitly re-owns claim_outbox_batch after CREATE OR REPLACE, and does not alter the other existing definer owners.

A catalog invariant tests the exact job_definer function allowlist. The migration test uses a non-superuser DDL owner on a fresh database with role provisioned out of band; app_worker positive and negative seats use a dedicated workerPool. CI and a fresh local compose cluster bootstrap the cluster role before migration.
